analyst_assumptions: Lease financing convention uses full ROU investment in enterprise cash flow and deducts existing lease liability once.
20% sustainable tax, 4.5% marginal lease borrowing cost, 4.5% D&A/replacement ratio and capital productivity are analyst estimates.
Growth and margin increases require incremental capital; no unrequested debt funding or buybacks.
Quarter-weighted economic equivalent shares are a proxy, not current award register.
Historical PEs are retrospective, with constant normal tax and identified one-offs only, not point-in-time backtests.
Liquidity principal schedule is a conservative diagnostic, not verified maturity timing; annual positive balance does not prove dated liquidity.
Peer screen ratios are unsynchronized secondary context only; no median price target.
